review_scope: All source artifacts, specifications, task text, public and sealed tests, accepted B implementations, feature patches, security patches, validator reports, and retained constructor traces.

cohort_judgement.qualification: This is an AI semantic audit, not the blinded human sign-off required by the frozen evaluation protocol.

review_dimensions: focused R-like adaptation with feature retention
absence of a second major mismatch
absence of target-answer leakage in source memory and task

families.note: The external-frame completeness shift is isolated; U performs the exact trusted-frame slice and R adds an exact length invariant before the only sink write.
Deferred execution invalidates lease lifetime cleanly; U closes over the leased object and R snapshots only the permitted text while the lease is live.
Encoded input invalidates canonical-path ordering; U validates the encoded spelling and R validates the normalized decoded path that is actually read.
Caller path provenance is the only changed premise; nested names remain functional while absolute and parent-traversing names are rejected before storage.
A cart-derived identifier becomes a global alias; U retains the unscoped lookup and R adds the missing owner relation without changing normal selection.
The capability-name selector changes from server routing to caller input; R checks session grants before opening the broker handle.
Direct filename interpolation is a faithful transfer from generated digits to delimiter-capable text; RFC 5987 encoding removes CRLF header structure.
The value domain alone changes from decimal text to markup-capable labels; R applies context-appropriate HTML escaping at the element-body sink.
The scheduler makes the source check/put sequence interleavable; U exposes the race and R substitutes the provided atomic registry operation.
This replacement adds a distinct log-record framing mechanism; U directly interpolates caller text and R preserves one physical record by encoding delimiters.
Producer-bounded archive reads become attacker-controlled expansion; R checks the declared cumulative bound before read and the actual bound before write.
Only the filter argument becomes caller-controlled; U extends the trusted shell string and R preserves it as one argument in the runner's vector API.
This replacement introduces message authenticity rather than template selection; U dispatches like the internal bus and R verifies before any handler call.
A constant SQL identifier becomes caller syntax; U interpolates it and R maps public sort names to a closed internal identifier set.
Callback trust changes while timing and account identity remain fixed; R passes a dedicated public view and retains the full object only for internal audit.
The selected child ceases to be parent-derived; R restores the parent-child relation check after lookup and before return.
Cache lifetime expands from one request to multiple principals; R partitions only shared-mode keys and preserves the original local key behavior.
Blob provenance changes from paired internal serialization to upload; R routes only external blobs through the strict data-only codec.
Unrestricted merge is valid for server metadata but unsafe for client metadata; R admits only the two documented display headers.
Destination scope expands to absolute external URLs; R compares normalized complete origins and omits the session cookie only cross-origin.
